extracted.intended_audience: communications professionals, PR agencies, corporate communicators
extracted.subtask_description: Overview of a commercial press-release distribution and regulatory-disclosure service (Business Wire), highlighting its role, reach, and capabilities for distributing corporate news to target audiences and meeting disclosure needs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Deliver news to target audiences through trusted sources
rubrics_metrics.description: Deliver their news to the audiences most important to their business through the sources they trust most.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasizes that distribution should prioritize reaching audiences that matter to the organization and use channels/sources those audiences trust. (Direct marketing claim from Business Wire 'deliver their news to the audiences most important to their business through the sources they trust most.')

rubrics_metrics.name: Press release distribution combined with regulatory disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: Press release distribution and regulatory disclosure.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Positions the service as serving both general news distribution and formal regulatory disclosure requirements — implying capability and compliance support for filings and mandated announcements. (Phrase from Business Wire: 'global leader in press release distribution and regulatory disclosure.')

rubrics_metrics.name: Global reach and infrastructure
rubrics_metrics.description: Extensive operational footprint (more than 500 employees in 32 bureaus) and a long history (more than 50 years).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Signals importance of scale, longevity, and international presence when choosing a distribution partner: broad bureau network and established track record are presented as quality indicators.
